ؑقاسمؑ کی لاش لے کر آتے ہیں رن سے سرور

۱
ؑہے خیمہ گاہ میں محشر آتے ہیں رن سے سرور
دولہا جسے بنا کر بھیجی تھا رن میں مادر
ؑلاشہ اُسی کا لے کر آتے ہیں رن سے سرور

۲

۳

۴

۵
دولہن شیقاب دیکھے لاشے کے یوں نہ ٹکڑے

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/qasim-ki-laash-le-kar-aate-hain-ran-se-sarwar.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
start = original.index(b'romanLyrics:')
end = original.index(b'\\n---\\n', start)
roman = \"\"\"romanLyrics: |-
  Qasim ki laash le kar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar

  1
  Hai khaima gaah meiṅ mahshar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar
  Dulha jise bana kar bheji tha ran meiṅ maadar
  Laasha usi ka le kar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar

  2
  Khaimoṅ meiṅ ja ke keh do masnad koi bichhao
  Dulha ki laash utha kar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar

  3
  Wo garm reg sahra paamaal gul sa laasha
  Roti hai ruh-e-Shabbar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar

  4
  Yuṅ dhundte haiṅ tukre jaise haiṅ phul chunte
  Ran meiṅ aba bichha kar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar

  5
  Dulhan shitaab dekhe laashe ke yuṅ na tukre
  Zer-e-aba chhupa kar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar

  6
  Momin haram meiṅ ghul tha wa Qasima ka barpa
  Kya sakht tha wo manzar aate haiṅ ran se Sarwar\"\"\"
p.write_bytes(original[:start] + roman.encode() + original[end:])
updated = p.read_bytes()
assert updated[:start] == original[:start]
assert updated[updated.index(b'\\n---\\n', start):] == original[end:]
source = original[end:].decode().split('\\n', 2)[2].strip()
def layout(lines, numbers):
    return [[line for line in block.splitlines() if line.strip() not in numbers] for block in lines.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
roman_body = '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in roman.splitlines()[1:])
counts = [len(block) for block in layout(roman_body, set('123456'))]
assert counts == [len(block) for block in layout(source, set('۱۲۳۴۵۶'))] == [1, 3, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]
print('Verified 14 verses across the opening and six numbered stanzas. Urdu body and other metadata are byte-identical.')
PY"

item.text:
Audited all 14 Urdu verses in [the lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/fc1bff5697164b3ba651b119301bba7e/src/data/lyrics/qasim-ki-laash-le-kar-aate-hain-ran-se-sarwar.md). Removed the extra Roman refrain fragment, aligned the opening and six numbered stanzas, and corrected supported spellings and nasal endings. The Urdu body and all other metadata are unchanged.

Two readings still need editorial confirmation. The Roman retains *Khaimoṅ* and *shitaab* where the Urdu reads `یموں` and `شیقاب`.
